title: Vincent, François, Paul and the Others
writer: Claude Néron, Jean-Loup Dabadie, Claude Sautet
actors: Yves Montand, Michel Piccoli, Serge Reggiani
plot: Three friends face mid-life crises. Paul is a writer who's blocked. François has lost his ideals and practices medicine for the money. The charming Vincent faces bankruptcy and his wife, from whom he's separated, wants a divorce.
